title.en: Magnetic Field of a Straight Current Carrying Wire
title.hi: सीधे धारावाही तार का चुंबकीय क्षेत्र
title.hinglish: Straight current carrying wire ka magnetic field

description.en: The magnetic field lines around a straight wire carrying current are in the form of concentric circles. The direction is given by the Right-Hand Thumb Rule.
description.hi: धारा ले जाने वाले सीधे तार के चारों ओर चुंबकीय क्षेत्र रेखाएं संकेंद्रित वृत्तों के रूप में होती हैं। दिशा दाएं हाथ के अंगूठे के नियम द्वारा दी जाती है।

svgContent:
<svg viewBox="0 0 400 300" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  <!-- Magnetic Field Lines (Concentric Circles) -->
  <ellipse cx="200" cy="150" rx="100" ry="40" fill="none" stroke="#3b82f6" stroke-width="2" />
  <ellipse cx="200" cy="150" rx="60" ry="24" fill="none" stroke="#3b82f6" stroke-width="2" />
  <ellipse cx="200" cy="150" rx="20" ry="8" fill="none" stroke="#3b82f6" stroke-width="2" />

  <!-- Arrows on Field Lines (Front side) -->
  <polygon points="200,190 190,185 190,195" fill="#3b82f6" />
  <polygon points="200,174 190,169 190,179" fill="#3b82f6" />
  <polygon points="200,158 195,155 195,161" fill="#3b82f6" />

  <!-- The Straight Wire -->
  <line x1="200" y1="250" x2="200" y2="150" stroke="#ef4444" stroke-width="6" />
  <!-- Wire passing through the plane (dashed part behind) -->
  <line x1="200" y1="150" x2="200" y2="130" stroke="#ef4444" stroke-width="6" stroke-dasharray="4" />
  <line x1="200" y1="130" x2="200" y2="50" stroke="#ef4444" stroke-width="6" />

  <!-- Current Arrow -->
  <line x1="180" y1="220" x2="180" y2="180" stroke="#ef4444" stroke-width="2" />
  <polygon points="180,180 175,190 185,190" fill="#ef4444" />

  <!-- Plane representing cardboard/surface -->
  <path d="M100,110 L300,110 L260,190 L60,190 Z" fill="#e5e7eb" opacity="0.5" stroke="#9ca3af" stroke-width="2" />
</svg>
